title: pingdotgg/t3code#665: Feature: Option to delete non-empty Project

messages.body: # Status quo Given I have a project with more than one thread When I want to delete the project Then the UI blocks that, asking me to delete all threads first # Proposal Instead of the notification, open a dialog to confirm deletion of non-empty project: "Deleting `` will also delete all threads" -> confirm/cancel
Hopefully, #651 will help address this issue in the meantime. It will allow you to bulk select project threads and delete them.
